name: Matcha Green Tea Oat Milk Latte
caffeineNote: Ceremonial matcha; caffeine not stated on the label
summary: Ceremonial matcha whisked into organic oat milk, with no coffee in the can at all. The front reads “no refined sugar”, which is true as far as it goes — but the panel lists 12 g of added sugar from coconut nectar, so every gram of sugar in this can is added. Refined and added are different claims. 3 g of protein per 8 oz can at 150 calories.
